_help.site_name: Required. Physical site / building this machine belongs to. Shown on the report.
_help.client: Optional. Legal client name for the report + invoice trail. Defaults to site_name.
_help.contact_name: Optional. Primary client contact for follow-up on remediation.
_help.contact_email: Optional. Where the deliverable / questionnaire answers get sent.
_help.technician: Optional. Who ran the audit. Defaults to Ark Web Solutions.
_help.authorization: Optional. Signed authorization note for the report footer / audit trail.
_help._note: insurance-report.py reads this config plus the audit JSON produced by Invoke-SecurityAudit.ps1. The PowerShell scripts read the machine directly and do not need this file, but you pass site/authorization to them on the command line.
